'''Halo''' is a map with one vulnerable high LG in the central open area, with RL's in the areas that are less crucial for control. The RA is placed in a place with only 2 passages out, leaving one possibly trapped. The item set is pretty  much standard, with one high RL and one low RL.

Locs made by {{player|Flintheart|flag=se}}
